title: Sequin Lace High Low Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This sequin lace midi dress feels polished, feminine, and easy to wear. The V-neckline helps frame the upper body beautifully, while the short sleeves add light coverage and a refined finish. Finished with a softly flared hem and subtle side detail, it is a lovely choice for wedding guest dressing, cocktail parties, and other semi formal occasions.


Tips: Prioritize selecting based on the bust measurement; the entire garment is stretchy, and the waist and hip areas can stretch by at least 2 inches.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
